FAQPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQPage.subtitle: Home / Frequently Asked Questions
FAQPage.faqDescription: Find answers to the most common questions about our event planning services, booking process, and how we make your events unforgettable.

faqsLeft.question: What Types Of Events Do You Plan?
faqsLeft.answer: We plan a wide range of events including weddings, birthday parties, engagements, anniversaries, corporate events, product launches, themed parties, exhibitions, and private celebrations.

faqsLeft.question: How Early Should I Book My Event?
faqsLeft.answer: We recommend booking at least 3-6 months in advance for larger events like weddings and corporate functions, and 1-2 months for smaller parties to ensure date availability and optimal planning time.

faqsLeft.question: Can You Help With Venue Selection?
faqsLeft.answer: Absolutely! We have strong relationships with top venues across the region and can help you find the perfect location that matches your vision, guest count, and budget.

faqsLeft.question: Do You Provide Decoration And Theme Setup?
faqsLeft.answer: Yes, we provide end-to-end decoration services including floral arrangements, lighting, props, and custom theme execution tailored to your specific preferences.

faqsLeft.question: What Is Included In Your Event Planning Package?
faqsLeft.answer: Our comprehensive packages typically include venue sourcing, decor styling, vendor management, on-day coordination, catering arrangements, and detailed itinerary planning.

faqsLeft.question: Do You Handle Catering And Entertainment?
faqsLeft.answer: Yes, we collaborate with premium caterers and top-tier entertainment professionals to provide a seamless and memorable experience for your guests.

faqsRight.question: What Types Of Events Do You Plan?
faqsRight.answer: We plan a wide range of events including weddings, birthday parties, engagements, anniversaries, corporate events, product launches, themed parties, exhibitions, and private celebrations.

faqsRight.question: Can You Customize The Event As Per Our Requirements?
faqsRight.answer: Yes, every event we plan is fully customized. We work closely with you to understand your specific needs, style, and cultural preferences to create a truly personalized experience.

faqsRight.question: Do You Provide A Budget Estimate?
faqsRight.answer: Yes, after our initial consultation, we provide a detailed, transparent budget estimate outlining all expected costs so you can make informed decisions without hidden surprises.

faqsRight.question: How Do You Ensure Everything Runs Smoothly On The Event Day?
faqsRight.answer: We provide a dedicated on-site coordination team that manages vendors, follows the timeline strictly, and handles any unexpected situations so you can relax and enjoy your event.

faqsRight.question: What Is Your Cancellation Or Rescheduling Policy?
faqsRight.answer: Our policies vary depending on the scale of the event and the vendors involved. We outline all cancellation and rescheduling terms clearly in our initial contract for full transparency.

faqsRight.question: How Can I Get A Quote For My Event?
faqsRight.answer: You can easily get a quote by contacting us through our website's contact form, calling our office, or emailing us directly. We'll set up a consultation to discuss your needs.
